changelog:
Dawn + 
New Dawn magazine screensaver: rotating artwork with time, weather, HA entity states, calm magazine-style layout. Up to 4 entity slots, configurable wallpaper source, preloading, cache fallback. Path: Settings → Screensaver → Magazine & Content.

Dual Pages browser: two simultaneous live web surfaces, side-by-side landscape, stacked portrait. Adjustable split 1:9 to 9:1. Left/upper controlled by existing HA URL entity, right/lower by new second entity. Each pane independently focusable, refreshable, console-debuggable. Path: Settings → Browser → Page Display → Dual Pages.

Software Update center: full release notes, version selection, download-verify-install flow. Built-in or system downloader. Auto-update optional. Path: Settings → Device Services → Software Update. Thanks @realroywalker #156.

Lyrics: LRCLIB primary source, QQ Music fallback. Duration-aware matching, artist filtering, hysteresis for small corrections.

Microphone: software gain -24 to +24 dB. Recording device routing separate from AudioSource: Auto, Built-in, USB. Thanks @lone-baggie #157.

Broadcast intent: structured fields preserved, URI priority merge. Thanks @pantherale0 #155.

Media overlay pause recovery: minimal mode fades after 20s, clears stale metadata after 30s. Compact display fixes for 480x480.
